description: Source code for managing client certificate store using NSS in Chromium, including certificate filtering and private key acquisition.

classes.name: ClientCertIdentityNSS
classes.description: Represents a client certificate identity using NSS, capable of acquiring private keys.

methods.name: GetClientCerts
methods.description: Retrieves and filters client certificates based on the SSL request info.

methods.name: GetAndFilterCertsOnWorkerThread
methods.description: Fetches platform certificates and filters them according to the request.

methods.name: GetPlatformCertsOnWorkerThread
methods.description: Enumerates platform certificates and adds valid ones to the identities list.

methods.name: FilterCertsOnWorkerThread
methods.description: Filters certificates based on validity and issuer match.
